edges.description: Fluid-dominant capsule disease produces a clinically evident delayed peri-implant effusion.
intermediate_mechanisms: local tumor and capsule inflammatory fluid accumulation

edges.description: Mass-forming growth in the peri-implant capsule produces a palpable or imaging-detectable breast mass.
intermediate_mechanisms: localized solid tumor accumulation in the capsule
